subject.title: [Feature]: Background tasks pane in the Control UI chat view

question: Should Control UI embed agent-scoped background-task management beside chat, with shared task-domain consolidation across existing surfaces?
rationale: The feature is technically feasible and vision-aligned, but it adds persistent pane chrome and another task-management surface; the protected `maintainer` label reserves that placement and ownership choice for maintainers.

options.title: Consolidate and add rail
options.body: Extract reusable task state, actions, permissions, and presentation, then add a collapsible agent-filtered rail beside chat.

options.title: Use badge and deep links
options.body: Keep full task management centralized while adding a running-count badge and direct task or transcript navigation from chat.

recommendation.title: Consolidate and add rail
recommendation.body: Extract reusable task state, actions, permissions, and presentation, then add a collapsible agent-filtered rail beside chat.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing background-task UI, owns recent adjacent chat-layout work, and authored this product request.
